name: Relaticle
description: Run an open-source CRM that agents can operate directly — 37 MCP tools plus a REST API over an agent-native schema, with approval gating on writes and self-hosted deployment.

skills.name: Record Management
skills.description: Creates and updates companies, people, opportunities, and notes through MCP tools mapped to CRM objects.

skills.name: Approval Gated Writes
skills.description: Routes agent-initiated changes through a human approval step before they commit to the CRM record.

skills.name: Pipeline Queries
skills.description: Answers questions about deal stages, owners, and activity by querying the CRM rather than a stale export.
